notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Void Hunters![/h3]

Today is a very special day, [b]a huge milestone for Soulstone Survivors![/b] We are releasing the [b]largest update the game has ever seen[/b], along with the [b]full release announcement[/b], [b]key art updates[/b], [b]supporter pack DLC[/b]… there is so much to cover, so let’s get started!

[h2]Soulstone Survivors 1.0 is coming June 17th![/h2]
That’s right but that’s not all! We are also super excited to announce that [b]the game is also coming with a simultaneous release to Playstation 5 and Xbox Series S | X![/b] Check out our full announcement in the link below, including [b]our new announcement trailer![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2066020/view/530970142088102701

[h2]New Art + Logo![/h2]
To mark this milestone, we completely [b]revamped the game’s key art and logo,[/b] as a reflection of how much the game changed and evolved through Early Access, thanks to your amazing support! Let us know what you think about the new visuals in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/c0b8c07f6f41bf6b1577fb8c9350807411404616.png[/img]

[h2]New Supporter Pack DLC![/h2]
We are always incredibly humbled by the support we get from the community. We’d never imagine that people would like the game so much that they’d ask us for a way to support it even further. With you in mind, we’ve created our [b]Supporter Pack[/b], which is an additional content you can purchase to [b]give you access to 1 special skin per character, as well as a special thank you badge on the main menu![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53057/Soulstone_Survivors__Supporter_Pack/

So if you enjoy the game and want to support it further, check it out, but if not that’s alright too, [b]we already can’t thank you enough for playing the game and all the help we’ve got through Early Access![/b]

[h2]Update 16 - The Titan Hunt[/h2]
Now let’s get to the good stuff, the reason you are here! Today we are releasing the [b]BIGGEST[/b] update the game has ever seen, so without further ado lets jump right in! There is so much we want to show you that we decided to make a little [b]update trailer that you can check out below![/b]

[previewyoutube=Fw8-kwCWtIY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Game Mode: The Titan Hunt![/h2]
Your endless search for power and answers leads you to distant lands, in a brutal hunt for the Titans. [b]Their blood is the key[/b], and it’s up to you to take their power and put it to good use!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/44ae8abed3eb3f52c1fb2e4cc2bdb6f35a23b694.png[/img]

In this mode you travel through [b]Unstable Portals[/b] through different regions of the world in search of the next titan to hunt. Complete a series of challenges, [b]collect Void Fragments and use them to break the Titan’s seal[/b], and prepare for war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/5463b717828a409c88d13b30d0f3cf27b5bf4e2e.png[/img]

With the seal broken, all that is left is to face the Titans, [b]ancient foes that shaped the very essence of this world![/b] The spoils await for those who rise up to the challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/8694372f19192cff81dba2ee667fd76ff5fb42f5.png[/img]

As you eliminate these powerful foes, [b]collect their blood and learn new, build-defining powers,[/b] adding hundreds of new synergies that will [b]elevate your Void Hunters to the next level! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/b24563bd3ec844c71b721af97de8536953c56d6e.png[/img]

This update marks [b]Part 1[/b] of the [b]Titan Hunt[/b], with [b]Part 2 coming with the full release in June 17th[/b], so get ready, for there is still much to find out about the mysteries of the void!

[h2]New Void Hunter: The Shaman![/h2]
In your search for blood and power, only [b]the wisdom of the Shaman may keep the Void Hunters true to their purpose[/b] and protect them from corruption. This [b]whip-wielding warrior[/b] uses totems to harness the powers of his ancestors, with a [b]unique playstyle that focuses on high health and static defences to keep the void at bay.[/b]

Now you can craft [b]new weapons[/b], unlock [b]unique skills[/b], [b]runes[/b] and [b]perform an ancient ritual to call your spirit guides[/b] into battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/c21e4cc8f2ae8c55f54624a8c066a1e1e0df3052.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/8aaf461e004b5b508876baad0a8baf71aa93db4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/f244c7aed4961efd5503aa8f124f848181b90412.png[/img]

[h2]New Buff - Ancestry[/h2]
Along with the Shaman we are introducing Ancestry, a [b]new buff[/b] where you can accumulate and spend stacks to [b]summon a powerful totem that harnesses your own life essence[/b], dealing increased damage based on your maximum health!

[h2]New Skill Trait - Fortitude[/h2]
This update also brings the [b]Fortitude[/b] skill trait! Units summoned by skills with this trait [b]deal extra damaged based on your maximum health[/b], in a powerful combo of resilience and strength!

[h2]New Feature: Minimap Support![/h2]
You will also notice a new feature across the game, [b]the Minimap![/b] It comes with information about all sorts of things, [b]from ascensions to minerals to bosses and enemies…[/b] it is filled with useful information to help you find your footing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/4fe2af5671af2d3cac0d9c9e227fe771f061d184.png[/img]

[h2]New Feature: Bonus Challenges[/h2]
While playing in the [b]Void Fields[/b] or the new [b]Titan Hunt[/b] you may notice a few new things going on around you… [b]loot chests, huge minerals, or even the sneaky Treasure Bug[/b] traveling through the planes… these optional special events can be completed to get some of that [b]sweet sweet loot![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/fa25f7639017bc7cd08e385914ae9f43de61315d.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Visuals: Menu and more[/h2]
As we get closer and closer to the game’s full release, we are bringing [b]even more visual updates to the game![/b] You may notice the menu is a bit… different now… and it all has a reason to be… the answers as to what is going on with the Void Hunters… why are you even hunting titans… [b]it all lies in our next major update, so keep an eye out![/b]

[h2]General fixes and improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made small changes to achievements to accomodate the new game mode. Completing the 5 Void Fields maps will now unlock the Unholy Cathedral, and completing the first ritual in the Cathedral unlocks the Titan Hunt. Previous rewards were moved to different achievements;
[*]Fixed a possible crashing issue when there were too many units active (such as from tons of summons);
[*]Added Rune Tooltips when you hover over a rune, to make it easier to find what you are looking for;
[*]Heat Explosion no longer deals extra damage based on your Area of Effect, it now consumes all Burn damage accumulated on the target, dealing 200% of the total damage instantly;
[*]Subdue base damage increased from 50 to 100, and damage per stack from 8 to 30;
[*]Bombardment, Cluster Bomb and Trickster Decoy now have their negative effects also scaling with the damage multiplier of those skills;
[*]Shrapnel Bomb base damage reduced from 375 to 200, and damage per stack reduced from 20 to 4;
[*]Chaoswalker’s ascension blessings are now considerably stronger, and may no longer grant you additional movement speed so that movement is still predictable;
[*]Reduced the interaction time of Chaoswalker’s ascension considerably;
[*]The Chaotic trait now has double the chance to chain into another skill;
[*]Adjusted the scroll speed in the Damage Breakdown popup;
[*]Chaotic Surge and Krakens Rum no longer count as area skills;
[*]Multiple usability fixes on interfaces across the game;
[/list]

[h2]1.0 Price Increase and Special 40% Discount[/h2]
It’s crazy to look back and see [b]how much the game changed and evolved across Early Access[/b], and we cannot thank you enough for your support along the way. It has been a long road, but one we are extremely proud of and happy to be taking, and with the full release just around the corner, we felt it was the time to [b]adjust the game’s price to reflect all of the new content available in the game.[/b]

We have decided to [b]increase the game’s price from $9.99 to $14.99 starting on May 12th[/b], just over two weeks from now, and to give you a chance to get the game at its lowest price it has ever been, we will be participating in the Steam’s Eastern Games Fest and running a [b]special discount of 40% off from April 23rd (in about one hour) to May 2nd![/b] If you were waiting for the right time to get into the fray, [b]that time is now![/b]

[h2]Special thanks to you![/h2]
Working on Soulstone Survivors over these past couple of years has been an incredible honor, and we could not be more thankful! We could never have dreamt how far the game would come and what direction it would take, and [b]we hope you are as excited as we are about all the new content and full release[/b], which is a huge milestone for the game, but not the end! Rest assured [b]we already have content planned for post release updates, and there is still much to reveal as we get closer to June 17th![/b]

We hope you will enjoy this massive update, and we will see you in the next one, Void Hunter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0613ae8b16cc071c726ac24a6c6e0f9156b2c8a2.gif[/img]

[b][i]~ Soulstone Survivors team[/i][/b]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]

While our [b]next major update is right around the corner,[/b] we have identified a [b]critical issue[/b] with [b]EA Update 15 - Community Skins[/b] and decided to make yet another tiny hotfix update to address this issue sooner rather than later.

We have received some reports that the game can get indefinitely stuck in the initial loading screen. This seems to happen mostly with players in China. 

This hotfix changes how the initial game loading works so that we no longer have to wait on some non-essential systems before proceeding to the menu. This should hopefully solve the infinite loading.

[h3]If you do run into the infinite game loading issue with version 15a6 or later, please contact us at support@gamesmithing.com or directly on our Discord![/h3]

We appreciate all the support and the patience, and hopefully this small update will make the experience smoother for all of you!

Hope you have a great day,

notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Survivors! :cozyroe:[/h1]

[h3]The [b]Unholy Cathedral[/b], our [b]12th major update[/b] is finally here, and this update brings [b]a lot of new content[/b] and improvements, including a [b]new game mode[/b], [b]major ascensions changes[/b] and a lot of [b]performance improvements[/b]![/h3]

[previewyoutube=7eKdF_SEEAA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]New Game Mode - The Unholy Cathedral[/h3]
[list]
[*] Venture into the [b]Unholy Cathedral[/b] and face a challenge like none before! You will need to [b]master each character[/b], exploring all the possible builds and variations that they bring, all culminating into an [b]epic battle against the heretic himself![/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/620caef2000ea88165180ef5ee276c3802db4f39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/9c558610b05094c0024b1cd1241360bebdc69999.png[/img]

[h3]Major Ascension improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] While Ascensions are meant to be different, our goal is to make sure that [b]all ascensions are incredible power boosts[/b] during a match and always interesting to go after. With that goal we have implemented major improvements to a few ascensions that were in dire need, you can check out all the changes below!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/7a8122a2f22b1e11aecd255fee6ca0ec08137519.png[/img]

[h3]New Artifact Powers[/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Barbarian[/b] and the [b]Sentinel[/b] now have access to brand new powers with their Artifact Weapons! These powerful skills become available whenever you [b]upgrade their weapons to the Artifact rarity[/b] and can provide a significant boost to power! More artifact powers will be coming with future updates!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/2df57d7a5e87c293a8fcbb7fd39c3f80abb43755.png[/img]

[h3]Performance improvements (more still coming)[/h3]
[list]
[*] This update brings [b]the first step into a ton of upcoming performance improvements[/b]. Hopefully you will notice that the gameplay is smoother including in deeper endless runs. The game should use [b]considerably less memory[/b] an overall feel better to play. [b]There are still major performance improvements coming[/b] (such as the collision detection we mentioned in our devlog, which is still not present in this update), so keep an eye for the next update!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/4e435ccbefb53b43338b9330e2c6b9787035f821.png[/img]

[h3]New Skill Trait: Cunning[/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiple Summon skills now have the new Cunning trait, where units summoned prioritize high value targets such as Elite enemies and Lords of the Void. This trait is now commonly found in most damage focused summon skills and should make summoning skills even more powerful than before.
[/list]

[h3]Ascension changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Necromancer and all of its summons now gain multiplicative stats based on how many abominations are currently active, making it considerably stronger than before;
[*] The Death Knight and all of its summons now gain multiplicative stats based on how many Ebon Knights are currently active, making it considerably stronger than before;
[*] The Beastmaster’s footprints now have a tracker even when they are on your screen, making them much easier to find. They are now also closer to each other, and avoid being too close to walls;
[*] The Beastmaster now requires 8 footprints, down from 10, to spawn exotic beasts. Exotic Beasts now have the Cunning trait as well, making them considerably stronger than before;
[*] The Pyromancer now gains concentration twice as fast, and loses half as much when taking damage;
[*] The Pyromancer’s skill Draconic Flames can now be aimed, instead of being fired at a random target, making it considerably stronger than before;
[*] The Chaoswalker’s altars now have a much smaller and smoother collision profile, and should not get in the way as much as before;
[*] The Chaoswalker now gains Chaos Energy twice as fast;
[/list]

[h3]General changes and fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new options in the Fight panel to allow you to disable individual pieces of your meta progression, so you can customize how you play;
[*] Changed the Engineer individual skill tree node from granting Mineral drop bonuses to granting Attack Speed (making it so engineer no longer have a slight increase in material gains compared to other characters);
[*] Fixed an issue where Dazed was not having any effect on enemies, should now work as intended;
[*] Fixed an issue where Distracted and Debilitated were not being calculated properly, making them more effective than they should be especially in endless and overlord runs;
[*] Fixed an issue where you would get more Artifact Power than intended with every Endless or Overlord map;
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple instances of a certain Synergy power up would count as multiple sources of a debuff, for example, picking Hypothermia twice would count as two sources of Disarray, when it should only count as one;
[*] Fixed an issue where the “More Details” key bind would not work as intended. Requires a new key bind to be set to fix the issue if you had this problem;
[*] Fixed an issue where skill tree nodes that boosted your ascension could fail to load (not common but could happen);
[*] Implemented visual improvements for a few skills that would very early entirely hide red damage areas, such as Blizzard and Ice Vortex;
[*] Fixed an issue with a Myrmidon’s skill tree node granting much more critical chance than it should;
[*] Fixed the damage areas of a few basic and elite enemies that were unable to cause damage;
[*] Fixed an issue where Electrified could be consumed without properly releasing its burst of energy;
[*] Fixed an issue where the Hound Master dogs would not properly receive stats from the skill tree;
[*] Fixed an issue where certain effects would remain in the scene indefinitely;
[*] Changed the name of the underlying skills related to Icy Veins, Purity, Electrified and Radiance to reflect the name of the buff, so it is easier to understand;
[*] Minor fixes all across the game;
[*] Added the Cunning trait to the following Summon skills:
[list]
[*] Death Knight’s Ebon Knights
[*] Beastmaster’s Exotic Beasts
[*] Beastmaster’s Wolves (Skill Tree)
[*] Monkey King’s Black Clones
[*] Myrmidon’s Loyal Servants

[/list]

We hope you will enjoy all the new content added with this update and do let us know in the comments below what you think!

Thank you all very much for your support and we hope to see you in the next one, there is a lot of cool stuff still in the oven!

Have a great day!

notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This is Allan, the lead developer of Soulstone Survivors. Today we are making a hard decision.

[h2]We are TEMPORARILY reverting the "New Beginning" update entirely, in response to the negative feedback of the update. If you like the update, please check the instructions of how to access it below.[/h2]

[h3]What happened?[/h3]
On the 28/03 we released the “New Beginning” update, which brings a bunch of new systems and changes all across the game. Many of the changes were not well received, so while we are working on addressing the feedback, we have reverted the game to the previous version.

[h3]What about the new character, runes, etc?[/h3]
These will all be reintroduced to the game as soon as we fix the issues with the new update. This was a massive update, and while we are working all day long to address the feedback, it will take some time until everything is addressed.

[h3]What happens to my skill tree? I had already purchased nodes in the Monkey King skill tree![/h3]
These are still kept, and when the update is reintroduced, you will not have lost any progress. The only change will be the runes. If you had any of the new runes equipped, it will be automatically unequipped.

[h3]When can we expect those changes?[/h3]
When they are ready. We will not risk promising a date now, as the most important thing is getting the update to the place where it needs to be. If you want to help us in this process and voice your concerns, we will probably start alpha testing these chances to the update on our Discord very soon. As mentioned we are working around the clock, but it is hard to know exactly how long this process will take.

[h3]Playing the "New Beginning" update[/h3]
While we work on addressing the issues with the new update, you can still play it in a new branch on Steam called "newbeginning". To access it, you must do the following:

1 - Right click the game name on your Steam Library and go to Properties:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/3503b07909bf3e7b80701d148f999b38bbd0d3c0.png[/img]

2- Click on "Betas", and then click on "New Beginning";
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/91794057f40a9d1d56be2d61018fcd705757ecfe.png[/img]

[h3]Developer notes[/h3]
I won't lie, this is a very hard decision for me and the whole team. We are a small company, pouring our hearts and souls into this game, sacrificing pretty much all of our personal lives to make this game as good as it can be, but at the end of the day, we are human, and we can make mistakes.

We took a chance to try and make the game better, but we clearly did not hit the mark, at least not to all of you. All that is left to do is learn from the experience, and move forward. We will continue giving our best to make Soulstone Survivors the best game it can be, and must ask for a bit more patience before we are ready to re-release this update and all the new content it brough with it. 

I really apologise for the confusion and inconvenience, and it really breaks my heart to be writing this message today instead of watching all of you enjoying the game, and I hope we will be able to make right by you on the next one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0613ae8b16cc071c726ac24a6c6e0f9156b2c8a2.gif[/img]

[i][b]Allan Smith[/b][/i]

We have just released a small hotfix update which will deal with a few annoying problems in the game that would lead to multiple exceptions, which in turn would degrade the game's performance in certain scenarios. We hope that this small update makes your experience smoother!

[b]Full change list for version v0.11.037i:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Corrupted Pyromancer not working as intended, which would lead to considerable performance reduction and massive spam of errors;
[*] Static defense skills, such as Totems, Ballistae and Volcanos will now be alive for a minimum of 5 seconds. This prevents them being despawned to move closer to your before they are able to attack and should make those skills better in extreme scenarios;
[*] Fixed quite a few issues with VFXs, references and invisible errors that would degrade performance and lead to weird behaviour;
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support, and we see you in the next one! =)

notes.title: Hot fixes and balancing in new update v0.11.037h!
Major Update: 1 Year Anniversary Celebration
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hey, Survivors![/b] :cozyroe:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/9189c10e2c1a05cc5fe5334083c419405c63ce39.png[/img]

It's hard to believe but Soulstone Survivors is already completing 1 year of Early Access! A lot has changed and there is still much to come! We are so happy to have you with us for this incredible journey, and to celebrate the occasion we want to present to you the Anniversary Update!

Have fun with the new special decorations from Nov 6th to Dec 10th and make sure to check out the [url=#Anchor][b][u]Speedrun Challenge[/u][/b][/url] we are hosting to celebrate the update! Now let’s jump into it!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New content and features:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b] Steam Trading Cards:[/b][/h3]
Earn Steam Trading Cards by just playing the game, complete the set, and earn unique badges, Steam Profile backgrounds, and emotes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/cec971861914d3ce1f509c969b3a2f089f635150.png[/img]

[h3][b]Major Runes rework:[/b][/h3]
You can now have up to 5 rune presets for each character, and now have two types of rune slots, Versatility and Tenacity:
[list]
[*] Versatility - 3 slots:
These are runes that allow you to customize your build and what powers you can have access to in a match, those include all Mastery, Affinity, and Inclination runes, Gambler, and so on. These runes no longer have a Runic Power cost and are limited only by the number of Versatility slots;
[*] Tenacity - 4 slots:
These are runes that increase your fighting power one way or another, be it by increasing your damage, movement speed, defenses, and so on. These runes still cost Runic Power and are also limited by the number of Tenacity slots;[/list] 

[h3][b]Mastery Runes rework:[/b] [/h3]
In addition to the changes above, Mastery runes now allow you to choose UP TO 5 skills from the desired skill type. Whenever you equip a Mastery rune you are guaranteed to have the selected skills in your pool of skills during a match;

[i](Dev notes: We want players to experiment with as many builds as possible, and we know that prior to this change players would often prefer focusing their limited runic power into runes that directly make you more powerful instead of trying to experiment with varied and possibly whacky builds. We hope that with this change (and the changes listed below) you will have more freedom to create any builds you can dream of more predictably.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/06e3d8328b83dfd5ebfd8facdd1e29ef14147ea4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Match History screen:[/b][/h3]
You can now view a list of your previous matches, including skills used, times, damage per skill, and so on, along with an overview of your account and character comparisons! The game already recorded most information about your matches so you can see retroactive stats (missing a few details that will be included only on matches in the new version). We would love to see your account overviews so please do share your screenshots with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/f909b3d4cf5d0aed4fb8a1566c25ad92ddc994d8.png[/img]

[h3][b]New enemies:[/b][/h3]
The Dungeon of Despair is now infested with undead! All enemies have been completely revamped with 19 new enemies between regular and elite versions, along with an entirely new soundtrack! There are also a few new enemies in the Scorching Valley and the Whispering Grove!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/4b71647f85e5c6624be0570bbedce211d0f2dae6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/509022ff52de828b8c9dcd951e5d73709662a23a.png[/img]
[h3][b]
Power Up visibility rework:[/b][/h3]
Completely revamped tooltips and descriptions of all skills and power-ups in the game, to drastically reduce the amount of text while showing more details than before. These changes make it easy to know whether you already have a version of a certain power, how it improves with multiple pickups, and so on. We also reduced considerably the number of powers in the bottom left corner of the screen, focusing the information as much as possible;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/8c07179020cced3313a4278defb7faca8d83b397.png[/img]

[h3][b]Chaos Skills rework:[/b][/h3]
Chaos skills no longer are capable of applying every negative effect in the game. You will find that they now cause random damage (more than before), and also one of these two things:
[list][*][b]Apply Disarray:[/b] a new negative effect that increases all damage received by a random value between -0.5% and 2.5% per stack for 8 seconds, where damage can never be reduced below 1.
[*][b]Have the Chaotic trait[/b], which gives you a chance to cast another random skill instantly when this skill is used.

[i](Dev notes: Chaos skills are all about randomness and unpredictable effects, however, their ability to apply all types of negative effects becomes so powerful, especially on longer matches, that they can single handedly replace almost all skills in the game and still grant all the benefits. This harms build variety and makes many skills worthless in comparison, so we hope that these changes above will make Chaos skills no longer suppress other skills in the game, but still be very interesting to mix and match with various skill types in the game, offering new strategies to create broken builds and more interesting decisions.)[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Damage Breakdown during match:[/b][/h3]
We have finally added a way for you to view the damage breakdown of your skills during a match, without having to wait till the end of a match to see how skills are performing. Simply pause the game and check!

[h3][b]Visibility improvements:[/b][/h3]
While this will be a continuous work, with this update we have revisited the visual effects of loads of skills to make it so they are less invasive, in order to improve overall visibility. In addition to that, you can now adjust the Special Effect Visibility slider with hotkeys, making it a lot easier to adjust up and down. We will continue working with the goal that one day this visibility slider won't be necessary, but until we get there, we want your experience to be as smooth as possible.

[h3][b]Character changes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Reduced Chaoswalker Altar interaction time from 1 to 0.5 seconds;
[*]Divine Inspiration (Paladin's Ascension) slightly reworked: now if you miss the inspiration buff for any reason, a holy sphere will be left behind in its place. This sphere lasts for 20 seconds, and yields a diminishing amount of inspiration over time.

[i](Dev notes: while ascensions are meant to have different levels of interaction and difficulty, we felt that the Paladin's could be quite punishing. This change still rewards you for being in the right place, at the right time, but offers a "consolation prize" if for any reason you are unable to reach the holy light in time)[/i];[/list]

[h3][b]Skill changes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Renamed Chaos Bomb into Chaotic Explosion;
[*]Renamed Poison Bomb into Poison Puddle;
[*]Removed the Bomb tag from Acid Rain, Avalanche, Chaotic Explosion and Poison Puddle;

[i](Dev notes: the bomb tag was massively overcrowded in comparison with all other tags, not only diluting the pool of skills but adding thematically inaccurate skills to various characters)[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Rune changes:[/b][/h3] [list]
[*] Misfortune's Embrace now applies only damaging negative effects randomly, between Burn, Bleed, Poison and Doom, with 250% of the potency as before (no longer applies all effects randomly);[/list]

[h3][b]General changes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]New language supported: Traditional Chinese, with Italian and Turkish coming very soon!
[*]Portals now need to be interacted with for a second before they activate, to avoid accidental activation;
[*]Added special visuals to the Void Presence's attack so it can be easily distinguishable from regular enemy attacks;
[*]Fixed an issue where when selecting a skill in the level up panel, it would not consider your existing powers that would improve that skill if that skill was selected (for example, a Nature skill will now show its damage taking into account your existing +Nature Damage powers, if any);
[*]Added new key bind to enable/disable auto aim with a click (default middle mouse button), in addition to a small visual indicator next to the Dash icon;
[*]You can now pick Powers in the level-up screen with the keys 1, 2, 3 for faster navigation;
[*]Added option to hide the negative effects display from health bars;
[*]Skill List popup will now show what achievement is required for each skill in its tooltip;
[*]Improved interaction on the skill tree with the mouse to make it faster to purchase nodes with double clicking;
[*]Made the rotation of all units smoother;
[*]Hidden Skill Bar while the Replace Skills popup is active to avoid confusion;
[*]You can now select a character in the Character screen by double-clicking its picture;
[*]Adjusted multiple configuration errors with enemies in all maps, such as incorrect experience numbers, incorrect rate of spawn in certain cases, and so on, which would influence the pacing of the game seemingly at random;
[*]Made updates to the Dungeon of Despair visuals;
[*]Added new menu animations to celebrate the anniversary;
[*]Fixed issue where you could have curses that increased the frequency of Corrupted Void Hunters without spawning any void hunters;
[*]Fixed issue where corpses in some cases could rotate towards you;[h1 id="Anchor"][/h1]
[*]New animation and effects for Arcane Weaver in the menu;
[*]Fixed interactions between Ready for Battle, Unconventional Start, and Affinity runes;[/list]
[h1 id="Anchor"][/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[h2 id"Anchor"][b]New Speedrun Challenge[/b][/h2]
To celebrate the anniversary we’re hosting a speedrun challenge on our Discord server! Play on the map you’re most comfortable with be as fast as you can! But don't worry too much, every participant has a chance to win!

We’re giving the following [b]PRIZES[/b] to the 5 people with the best times:

[list][*] 🥇1st place - 20$
[*] 🥈2nd place - 15$
[*] 🥉3rd place - 10$
[*] 4th place - Game Key
[*] 5th place - Game Key[/list]

➡️[b]The 4th and 5th place will be picked randomly from all participants so everyone has a chance to win![/b] 

[h3]👉Join our Discord and go to the “[url=https://discord.gg/gamesmithing][b][u]👑speedrun-event[/u][/b][/url]” channel for more info.
[/h3]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Developer notes[/b]
[/h2]
We want to say a big thank you for the last year, it was an amazing journey. We are thankful to you for all the support you have given us and we hope to continue delivering the game we all love so much. There is still a lot of new content coming, and a ton of other improvements as well, but we hope you will have fun with the new update and as always, if you have any feedback or issues, let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0613ae8b16cc071c726ac24a6c6e0f9156b2c8a2.gif[/img]

[b][i] 
~ Soulstone Team [/i][/b]

notes.title: HOTFIX UPDATE V0.10.036A
MAJOR UPDATE: FROSTBORN WRATH IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

We know you’ve been waiting a long time for this, and today, finally, we bring you the biggest update so far,  [b]Frostborn Wrath![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/9d1d801f2bc1bde7cd068b05a4f21f3bbd0448b8.png[/img]

But before we get into the nitty and gritty of the patch notes, to celebrate the newly released update, we will be holding our first ever [i][b]Live Developer Q&A[/b][/i] this Tuesday, [b]September 12th at 5 pm UTC [/b]! If you have burning questions you’d like to ask directly to the developers, join us on Discord to participate, we will even give away a few Steam Gift Cards to the coolest questions we get!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/b1a60f1163d3b525a1a6ba856c4284f1c910c328.png[/img]

Now, here is the full list of changes of what is waiting for you in this update!

[h1]New Character Skill Trees![/h1]

Unlock new unique powers with Prestige levels for the remaining characters: Chaoswalker, Beastmaster, Assassin, Elementalist, Legionnaire, Necromancer and Death Knight;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/4cbb0575741f9345beb9c67bd9bf5bd8e98c7560.gif[/img]

[h1]More Void Hunter Ascensions:[/h1]

Discover the hidden powers and exclusive mechanics of the remaining characters, bringing their powers to the next level. This update includes the ascension powers for the following characters: Chaoswalker, Beastmaster, Assassin, Elementalist, Legionnaire, Necromancer and Death Knight;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0097d6911fb2ab083e581112f7c1dd959f5af6a7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/a8ad15af5be6a080198bae2aa4d8c307975c79d2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/9b9c86299b6fd35bdb655c2fd2400b41e4f15684.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/cc1468c6f6229cd80fcb035f2a2ebe2e05559349.png[/img]

[h1] 7 New craftable weapons:[/h1]

In this update, we have introduced new craftable weapons for the following characters!

Chaoswalker: [b]Azramiel's Blessing[/b]
Beastmaster: [b]Widow's Embrace[/b]
Assassin: [b]Tempest Edge[/b]
Elementalist: [b]Scepter of Darkness[/b]
Legionnaire: [b]Vulcan's Impaler[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/88aac2c90e95e209175aaa4617db67a8619d804a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/f1c05cbc14da9d39e584af8f00c91efe5034ee8d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/d74d63f9bcd2ba36f7bce001e8e4fdf9e02e7a87.png[/img]

[h1] 14 new active skills:[/h1]

You can now find the following active skills, exclusive to the new weapons! 


Chaoswalker: [b]Ripple of Light, Sanctified Orb[/b]
Beastmaster: [b]Spider Cocoon, Summon Spider Queen[/b]
Assassin: [b]Lightning Stab, Lightning Surge[/b]
Elementalist: [b]Shadow Cut, Dark Torrent[/b]
Legionnaire: [b]Piercing Flames, Incinerating Spear[/b]
Necromancer: [b]Murder of Crows, Carrion Crows[/b]
Death Knight: [b]Frost Strike, Glacial Affinity[/b]

[h1]22 new runes:[/h1]

Even more new special runes can be unlocked through the Skill Tree of each character, bringing even more ways to customize each run;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/8f0ca73f3977cee0afe8dd2cf192852783952a13.gif[/img]

[h1]New Enemies:[/h1]

The Frozen Wasteland is now filled with new dangers and powerful foes. All enemies have been completely revamped with 19 new enemies between regular and elite versions, along with an entirely new soundtrack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/f3ea6730d2d446fa5a686c72368ac2961ccdcd80.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/b87f4ec37cc7aea03bc866f6cd269ee41a15f716.png[/img]

[h1]New Skill List menu:[/h1]

Now, you can finally check the list of all skills a character has access to via the Characters menu!

[h1]New Negative Effects overlay:[/h1]

Now you can head on to the Settings menu and enable overlays on heath bars for each negative effect that causes damage in the game, such as Doom, Burn, etc;

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Skill Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Changed the order of the Spellblade Riftwalker skills[/b] so [i]Energy Pulse is the last skill, and Arcane Comets is the second skill[/i] to be used;

[*][b]Summon Skeletal Archer[/b] damage reduced from 200 to [b]140[/b];

[*][b]Summon Helper Elves[/b] damage reduced from 150 to [b]100[/b];

[*][b]Summon Skeletal Mage[/b] damage reduced from 350 to [b]180[/b];

[*][b]Frenzied Bunnies'[/b] negative effect power was reduced by approximately [b]15%;[/b]

[*][b]Skill Tree nodes[/b] that grant stats when you take damage now have limits to their bonuses;

[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h1]General changes and fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Player movement will now be more [b]responsive[/b], for example, when changing directions;

[*]The scenario will now become [b]transparent[/b] when it would be blocking your view of your own character and immediate proximity;

[*][b]All loot, currencies, materials, prestige,[/b]are saved every time you go through an endless portal, instead of only when the match ended;

[*]You can now use the [b]keyboard to learn skills[/b] in the Level Up panel;

[*]You can now see the [b]Weapon Special skill on the Blacksmith menu[/b] before crafting a new weapon;

[*][b]Arcane Weaver's Mana Crystals[/b] can now be collected instantly;

[*]Skill Tree nodes that grant stats when you take damage now have limits to their [b]bonuses[/b];

[*][b]Changed damage numbers at the ending screen[/b] to use text notation, so they are not as long and hard to see as before;

[*][b]Crystal Eggs[/b] in the Caves of Dhal Zhog now have a loading bar to display how long it takes to pick one up;

[*]Added option to [b]General Options[/b] so you can configure the minimum delay for picking up skills in the Level Up screen (to prevent accidental skill picks);

[*][b]Fixed[/b] an issue where the [b]Spellblade Riftwalker skills had multiple tags[/b], receiving more bonuses than they should;

[*][b]Fixed issue[/b] where [b]Synergy-type power-ups[/b] would not apply rune effects properly, such as Gangrene and Pulse of Agony;

[*][b]Fixed[/b] an issue where [b]Fissure Strike would aim under the crosshair[/b], with an incorrect angle;

[*][b]Fixed soundtrack[/b] not reverting from [b]Boss to Regular;[/b]

[*][b]Fixed an issue[/b] where you could [b]die[/b] as the Level Up screen would appear;

[*][b]Fixed an issue[/b] where a few enemies [b]would deal much more damage[/b] than intended, especially in endless modes;

[*][b]Fixed issue[/b] where when [b]changing resolutions with a gamepad, the game[/b] would lose track of the controller;

[*][b]Loads of other small fixes[/b] all across the game;

[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[u]
[h1]Developer Notes[/h1][/u]

While this update finally introduces the Ascensions and unique mechanics for the remaining characters, there is still a lot coming to the game. This was the longest time we went without an update, as it involved a lot of work and testing to make sure that the new features are cool and fun to interact with, but I wanted to reiterate that we are still fully committed to making Soulstone Survivors the best game it can be, and we continue working more than full time on it to make sure we can deliver cool stuff, as  fast as we can.

We have been wanting to host a Live Q&A for a long time, and it's been hard to find the time to do it with so much going on for this update (and some for the next update as well!), but we want you to know that we are always listening, and we believe that a Live Q&A will be awesome! A great way to talk about all the stuff that is in the game right now, the new stuff from the update, but also about all the suggestions we get, and some of the new stuff we already have in the works for the next update. Since the beginning we’ve been developing Soulstone Survivors very closely to the community, with the feedback that all of you have given us, and we want to improve on that, and we hope that you will join us this September 12th, at 5 pm UTC on Discord! We are a bit nervous haha but excited about being able to chat directly with everyone live!

We hope you will enjoy all the new stuff in this update, as always thank you very much for your support and patience, we continue giving our all to make sure the game is as good as it can be and we wouldn’t be able to do it without you!

[b]
- Dev Team[/b]

It's time for a long awaited update in Soulstone Survivors. Thank you for being patient with us while we've worked to put this together! Today we bring you one of the most significant updates [i]to the game yet![/i] [b]Path of Ascension.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0c63f8e01b1e1abe24aa4b5cc50313402015d9a1.png[/img]

notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been now 8 days since our last update, which for us feels like a lot of time, so we thought it would be a good idea to take a moment and share a little bit about our future plans and the content we are working on for the next major update. We want to be as transparent with you as we can (while trying to not spoil too much the content that is coming =P), and while this is a bit of a wall of text haha I hope it brings some clarity into what is coming in the future.

[h2]Release schedule[/h2]
First, while we like to do frequent and small updates to make sure that the experience is as smooth as possible, now that we are working on new content, it makes more sense to have a longer release schedule so we can work on more expressive features to make more of an impact in the game.

Our current plan is to [b]release the next major update around the second week of December[/b], and from that point on, [b]release content updates monthly[/b], which gives us enough time to work on cool stuff, make sure it all works well, and release quality content frequently. In between those major updates, [b]we will continue making hotfixes, balance and smaller improvement patches[/b] whenever necessary.

[h2]General improvements in our radar[/h2]
With the last patch, we addressed a lot of the most pressing issues with the game, including hundreds of bugs large and small, refactoring game modes, making sure the game is more resilient and that the initial Early Access experience was as smooth as we could make it. However, there are still quite a few quality of life and fixes pending for the next version.

We are still evaluating which fixes and improvements we will be able to get done in time, but very high in our priority list are some [b]controller navigation improvements[/b], accessibility options which include [b]mouse-only control schemes and color-blind options[/b], [b]more UI improvements[/b], and of course [b]quite a few bugs reported by the community[/b] are in our radar as well. I don't think we will be able to finish all of these in time, but know that these are important issues to fix for us and they are definitely coming sooner rather than later.

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
For the beginning of Early Access, our focus was on making sure that all classes and play styles were fun to experiment with and were viable to play with. The game offers quite a few tools that make it so certain builds will always be superior or even broken depending a bit on your luck, however, we are well aware that certain classes and play styles have a hard time in the more challenging content in the game, such as high Curse levels.

For next update, [b]we want to take a close look at skills and play styles that are struggling to keep up[/b]. We will never be able to make all builds of all characters with all runes be equally strong, but that is not the intention really. Some classes will always be more challenging in certain scenarios, and we believe that this variety is good for the game, given this is a single player experience (so far, who knows =P), however, we want as much variety as possible, and for that, we need to make sure that ALL skills can be viable one way or another. This will be a constant effort, and we will make sure to take it one step at a time with each update coming in the future.

[h2]New weapons and skills[/h2]
Probably the part of the game that has received the least attention so far, are the weapons. We currently have a total of 20 weapons including the basic ones, but that is only a fraction of our goal. Our plan is to continuously add new weapons until each character has at least 5 weapons to choose from, and we are very far from that goal at the moment.

With that said, we are already working on a lot of new skills and weapons, and while I still won't reveal what those look like just now, rest assured you will get quite a few new ones with the next update!

[h2]Map differentiation[/h2]
Another big shortcoming of the current version of the game for us is that all maps play pretty much the same. The resources offer some incentive to play on different maps, but, our goal is to have enough enemy diversity and different challenges per map that it actually feels different to play on different scenarios.

This is a big endeavour and will likely take multiple updates to get where we want it to be, as it will involve [b]creating lots of new enemies[/b], [b]new skills[/b] for those enemies and making sure that they lead to interesting gameplay scenarios that actually feel different from each other (we don't want to just make green goblins in the Whispering Grove and blue goblins in the Frozen Wasteland), but it is something that is already in the works in the background. It will take some testing, but its a very high priority for us.

[h2]New challenges[/h2]
In addition to the above, one of the areas we want to continue expanding the game for a long time still, is in creating new challenges. Those will come in multiple shapes and forms, with [b]new bosses[/b], [b]new game modes[/b], and [b]quite a few... secret encounters[/b] to find along the way. I wont go into too much detail at this time, but what I will say is that we have one of those planned for the next update, and we are developing these in a way that will make future content easier and faster to develop as well.

[h2]Interesting ways to spend your resources[/h2]
While new weapons and characters will require materials and soulstones to be crafted, those are finite and we don't want them to feel grindy or to take too long to unlock. We have other features planned such as expanding the skill tree, giving more meaning to prestige levels and so on, so there is still a lot coming that will consume resources, however, we are currently planning another major feature that should offer nearly endless ways to spend resources, in exchange for cool bonuses and variations to your gameplay and classes.

[b]This is a major feature that will not come with the next update which is still in the drawing board[/b], and it is a challenging feature to design because we want it to feel rewarding and impactful, but not mandatory and grindy, which is a hard balance to strike. However, we thought it was important to communicate that we recognise this as yet another big shortcoming with the current version of the game, and it will definitely be addressed in the updates to come.

[h2]Future content and goals[/h2]
Our number one goal with Soulstone Survivors, is to make sure that there were hundreds, thousands of ways you could play the game and have fun with. We feel like we currently have a really good start, but there are still many more features coming that will expand your choices and overall power level in different ways moving forward. 

Our next goal, is to offer enough variety of challenges, and activities to do in the game, to give you incentives to explore all of those ways to play the game. We believe we have a good basis right now, but there is still A LOT we can do in this sense, with enemy variety, unlockable challenges and so on.

And our third and final goal with every feature we think for the game, is to create content that feels well connected with the rest of the game, and that offers very high replay value. Once again I think we are going in the right direction, and this is a pillar for all of the features that are still to come.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
With this announcement, we wanted to shed some light into our vision for the game moving forward. As mentioned many times before, we see the Early Access as just the beginning of this journey, and with all of the above, we hope it shows you a little glimpse of the ideas we have in mind. Even when all of the above is implemented, there are still loads of different types of content we can explore in the game, and we have no intention of slowing down.

We continue hard at work on our side, we continue reading feedback everywhere we can, we really appreciate all of the amazing ideas that you guys have shared with us and I'm sure many of them will find their way into the game at some point in time, and we are also looking into different ways we can interact with the community.

Thank you very much for the amazing support, and we hope to have you along with us for the journey!

Best wishes,
- The dev team
